excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad student working as a museum preparator, dark brown hair, tanned skin, Latino ethnicity.
excavation_context.uniform: A soccer sport jersey worn UNDER a white lab coat, blue jeans and grey sneakers.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_4 is in a museum holding area, shining a flashlight at a newly arrived, heavy block of pebble-packed tan conglomerate matrix. Trapped within the packed gravel texture is a thick, water-worn theropod limb joint. Dramatic high-contrast spotlighting defining the bumpy pebble shapes, illuminating his soccer jersey showing underneath his unbuttoned white lab coat. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
